E2E fixture reply. The shape under discussion is:

```java
int safe = denominator == 0 ? 0 : numerator / denominator;
```

The guard is what matters here rather than the arithmetic: without it a zero denominator throws before anything downstream has a chance to react, and the caller sees a stack trace instead of a value. E2E-FULL-THREAD-TAIL-MARKER
